title: Hollow and Sigil
premise: Lena Vane, youngest member of the Hollow Guild—a dying order sworn to keep the magicless valley of Sigil hidden—finds tonight's date inscribed in a century-old prophecy book, revealing that the valley's invisibility was a bargain that is about to expire. Hunted by the usurper's inquisitors and guided by a disgraced guild archivist who knows more than he admits, she must leave the valley for the first time to unbind King Aldric from the crown-born entity that wears him. Along the way she learns her own guild engineered the binding to seize power, forcing her to choose between loyalty to the only family she has known and the truth that could free the realm. In the end, Lena breaks the crown at the cost of the valley's concealment, exposing the guild's crimes and founding a new order where justice answers to no throne.
about_author: L. M. Amberdale is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval charters before turning to fantasy. They write about institutions, oaths, and the quiet people who keep both.

chapters.title: The Date That Wasn't There
chapters.summary: Lena Vane, cataloguing the guild's sealed archive, finds tonight's date inked in a prophecy book older than the guild itself—and watches the ink still wet. Her mentor orders it burned. POV: Lena. Emotional beat: unease curdling into defiance as she realizes her whole life has been someone else's plan.

chapters.title: What the Valley Cannot Hold
chapters.summary: Inquisitors breach the valley's border for the first time in living memory; the wards fail exactly as the prophecy foretold. Lena flees with the book and a wounded stranger, Tam, who claims to serve the true king. POV: Lena. Emotional beat: grief and terror as home stops being safe.

chapters.title: A Crown of Borrowed Breath
chapters.summary: Outside the valley, Tam reveals the usurper is King Aldric's body animated by the crown-entity Vessel, which devours its wearers' wills. Lena's magic, dormant in Sigil, flickers awake painfully. POV: Tam. Emotional beat: his guilt over past failures meeting her reluctant wonder at the wider world.

chapters.title: The Archivist's Confession
chapters.summary: They reach exiled archivist Corwin Hale, who confirms the prophecy but confesses the Hollow Guild helped bind Aldric a century ago to rule through proxies. Lena refuses to believe it. POV: Corwin. Emotional beat: shame and the terrible relief of a long-held secret finally spoken.

chapters.title: Free Cities, Unfree People
chapters.summary: In the free city of Marrowgate, Lena sees refugees fleeing the usurper's advance and witnesses guild agents buying silence among the councils. She steals proof of the guild's payments. POV: Lena. Emotional beat: disillusionment hardening into resolve; loyalty begins to crack.

chapters.title: The Price of Names
chapters.summary: Guild hunters capture Tam and offer Lena amnesty if she surrenders the book. Visiting him in chains, she learns he once served Vessel and escaped by letting his brother die. POV: Tam. Emotional beat: betrayal and unexpected mercy—she frees him anyway, choosing truth over safety.

chapters.title: Where Justice Sleeps
chapters.summary: Corwin leads them to the Sunken Court, an outlaw tribunal beneath the mountains where the lawless judge the powerful. There Lena formally accuses the Hollow Guild before strangers. POV: Lena. Emotional beat: fear transfigured into purpose; justice outside the law demands everything she has.

chapters.title: The March of the Wearing Dead
chapters.summary: Vessel's armies sack Marrowgate; the tribunal's verdict arrives too late to save the city but names Lena heir to the unbinding rite. The free cities' remnants rally under her banner. POV: alternating brief sections. Emotional beat: despair at the cost, grim unity rising from ash.

chapters.title: Unbinding
chapters.summary: In the throne room, Lena reaches Aldric's buried mind while Vessel offers her power to spare the valley. She recites the unbinding as the entity tears at her memories of home. POV: Lena. Emotional beat: the climax—grief, temptation, and the choice to break rather than bargain.

chapters.title: Hollow No More
chapters.summary: The crown shatters; Aldric wakes old and broken but free, and the valley stands exposed to the world. Lena returns to rebuild the guild on open ground, its secrets surrendered to the new court. POV: Lena. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution—home lost, truth kept, a just order begun.
